“We Buy Sports Cards” ad templates

Graphics Studio makes buyback ads for card shops and collectors who buy baseball, basketball, football and other sports cards. Pick a design, type your phone number and area, and download an image ready for Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist, Instagram or a printed flyer.

See the sports cards designs Pricing

How it works

  1. Pick a design. Open the sports cards designs and click one. It opens in the studio with its colours, product picture and copy already in place.
  2. Type your details. Your phone number, website if you have one, and your ZIP or city. Save them once in your brand kit and every design fills them in.
  3. Download and post. Choose a size (square for feeds, 9:16 for stories, 8.5×11 for print) and download. The top 3 Sports Cards designs are on the free plan; Pro unlocks the rest.

What to put on a sports cards buyback ad

  • What you take: collections, rookies, vintage, graded slabs, sealed wax.
  • Whether you buy whole collections or single cards.
  • How you pay and where you meet.
  • Your phone number and your area.

Keep it to one headline, a few short selling points and one number. People scroll past an ad in a second; the ones that get texts are readable at a glance on a phone.

Questions

Which sports card designs are free?

The top 3 designs in the Sports Cards category are on the free plan. Pro unlocks every design in every category.

Will the ad name my town?

If you give the studio your ZIP code or city, templates with a service-area line name the towns around you. It is looked up in your browser and saved on your device.

Is it free?

You can design without an account. Downloading needs a free account: 3 downloads a week at 1080 pixels with a BUYBACK.AD watermark. Pro is $15 a month for 100 downloads a month up to 2160 pixels, no watermark, every design.
